Every safety sign is only the standard pictogram sign itself, with no text panel, caption or letters on or beneath it. Every icon, sign in this scene is completely blank: a plain colored surface with at most one simple pictogram, never any writing, labels or numbers. Every element of the diagram is a simple pictogram icon in a colored circle, with no label, caption or word next to it; arrows and lines are plain. The lower fifth of the frame is plain background only: no caption strip, no subtitle line, no words under the picture. Nobody in the scene talks: every character keeps a calm closed-mouth expression with lips together the whole time, no lip movement. Audio: only soft, quiet room ambience; no voice, no speech, no narration, no music. Walls are plain and clean, with no posters, whiteboards or signs unless described above; all books, screens, charts, calendars and labels are blank solid color shapes or simple pictograms; doors are plain, and any door plate, room sign or nameplate on or above a door is a blank solid-color panel with no characters, letters or numbers; shelves, binders and bottles have no labels. Absolutely no text, no letters, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no writing anywhere in the frame; no subtitles, no captions, no title bars, no speech bubbles; the spoken line is audio only and is never written on screen.
